data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter rating bar supporting half stars, precise fractional values, custom items and RTL layouts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display and capture user ratings with high visual flexibility. Supports half‑star snapping, arbitrary fractional ratings, custom item builders, and right‑to‑left layouts.
use_when: You need a rating input UI with custom icons or emojis
The app must support RTL languages
avoid_when: A simple numeric input or slider suffices
You need a full UI kit rather than a single widget
weaknesses: Only provides rating UI, no validation or data handling
data.minimal_example:
RatingBar(
  initialRating: 3.5,
  isHalfAllowed: true,
  filledIcon: Icons.star,
  emptyIcon: Icons.star_border,
  halfFilledIcon: Icons.star_half,
  filledColor: Colors.amber,
  onRatingChanged: (rating) => print(rating),
);
